text: 11月14日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在深圳出席亚太经合组织（APEC）工商咨询理事会第四次会议开幕式并致辞。何立峰指出，亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将在深圳举行，为亚太合作明确方向、凝聚力量。希望工商咨询理事会继续发扬开拓进取、开放创新的企业家精神，推动APEC向着构建亚太共同体目标再启航，为亚太区域协同合作、创新发展、互联互通做出新的贡献。
text_en: On November 14, He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the fourth meeting of the APEC Business Advisory Council in Shenzhen. He Lifeng noted that the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will soon be held in Shenzhen, setting the direction and pooling strength for Asia-Pacific cooperation. He expressed the hope that the Business Advisory Council will continue to carry forward the entrepreneurial spirit of pioneering progress and open innovation, push APEC to set sail again toward the goal of building an Asia-Pacific community, and make new contributions to regional coordinated cooperation, innovative development and connectivity in the Asia-Pacific.
